Statement). The findings of the investigation for all eight blocks previously discussed in the said paragraphs 10.4 to 10.11 are presented below again with more procedural details.

5.2.1 Wang Yan House (Block A)  
The investigation at Wang Yan House (Block A) was firstly conducted by StnO SHEK Ngai-chun on 26.11.2025. During the inspection, the main power switch was firstly found at the “OFF” position and the indicator lamp not illuminated. When the main power switch was turned to the “ON” position by StnO SHEK, the indicator lamp of the FS pump panel illuminated. The FAS was preliminarily tested by triggering the test switch but failed to work.
